        function renderMcpActivity() {

                const row = document.createElement('div');
                row.className = 'activity-item';
                const tool = document.createElement('span');
                tool.className = 'activity-tool';
                tool.textContent = item.tool;
                const status = document.createElement('span');
                status.className = item.status === 'success' ? 'activity-ok' : item.status === 'failed' ? 'activity-error' : 'activity-start';
                status.textContent = item.status === 'success' ? '✓ completed' : item.status === 'failed' ? '✕ failed' : 'calling…';
                row.append(tool, status);
                container.appendChild(row);
            });
        }

        function recordMcpActivity(tool, status) {
            if (status !== 'calling') {
                const pending = mcpActivity.find(item => item.tool === tool && item.status === 'calling');
                if (pending) {
                    pending.status = status;
                    pending.at = Date.now();
                    renderMcpActivity();
                    return;
                }
            }
            mcpActivity.unshift({ tool, status, at: Date.now() });
            renderMcpActivity();
        }

        async function callTool(tool, args = {}) {
            recordMcpActivity(tool, 'calling');

        async function refreshRouterData() {
            const container = document.getElementById('router-metrics');
            const recentContainer = document.getElementById('recent-decisions');
            try {
                const stats = await callTool("get_router_stats", {});
                
                // Update Metrics
                document.getElementById('router-metrics').innerHTML = `
                    <div class="flex justify-between"><span>Requests</span><span class="text-white">${stats.total_requests}</span></div>
                    <div class="flex justify-between"><span>Total Tokens</span><span class="text-white">${stats.tokens?.total || 0}</span></div>
                    <div class="flex justify-between"><span>Cost (estimated/projected difference)</span><span class="text-sky-400">$${(stats.cost_usd?.actual || 0).toFixed(4)} / $${(stats.cost_usd?.projected_difference || 0).toFixed(4)}</span></div>
                    <div class="flex justify-between"><span>Local / Cloud / Redacted</span><span class="text-white">${stats.routes?.local || 0} / ${stats.routes?.cloud || 0} / ${stats.routes?.redacted_cloud || 0}</span></div>
                    <div class="flex justify-between"><span>Fallbacks / Handling</span><span class="text-white">${stats.fallbacks || 0} / ${((stats.local_handling_rate || 0) * 100).toFixed(1)}%</span></div>
                    <div class="flex justify-between"><span>Avg Latency</span><span class="text-white">${(stats.average_latency_ms || 0).toFixed(0)}ms</span></div>
                    <div class="flex justify-between"><span>Feedback Approval</span><span class="text-white">${stats.feedback?.approval_rate == null ? 'No ratings' : (stats.feedback.approval_rate * 100).toFixed(0) + '%'}</span></div>
                `;
                renderQualityEvaluation(stats.quality_evaluation);

                // Update Decisions
                if (!stats.recent_requests || stats.recent_requests.length === 0) {
                    recentContainer.innerHTML = '<div class="text-slate-500 text-center py-2">No routed requests yet.</div>';
                } else {
                    recentContainer.innerHTML = stats.recent_requests.slice(0, 20).map(d => {
                        let egress = "LOCAL ONLY — NO EGRESS";
                        if (d.route === 'cloud') egress = "EXTERNAL — FULL MESSAGES";
                        else if (d.route === 'redacted_cloud') egress = "EXTERNAL — REDACTED MESSAGES";
                        
                        return `
                            <div class="p-2 bg-slate-900/50 rounded text-xs border border-slate-800 space-y-1">
                                <div class="flex justify-between">
                                    <span class="text-slate-500">${new Date(d.created_at).toLocaleTimeString()}</span>
                                    <span class="font-bold">${d.route.toUpperCase()}</span>
                                </div>
                                <div class="flex justify-between text-slate-300">
                                    <span>${d.provider}/${d.model}</span>
                                    <span>${d.latency_ms}ms | ${(d.input_tokens || 0) + (d.output_tokens || 0)} tokens</span>
                                </div>
                                <div class="flex justify-between text-xs text-sky-400">
                                    <span>${egress}</span>
                                    <span>${d.fallback_used ? 'FALLBACK' : ''}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        `;
                    }).join('');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                container.innerHTML += `<div class="text-red-400 text-xs mt-2">Error: ${err.message}</div>`;
                renderQualityEvaluation(null);
            }
        }

        function renderQualityEvaluation(evaluation) {
            const target = document.getElementById('quality-evaluation');
            if (!target) return;
            if (!evaluation?.available || !evaluation.summary || !evaluation.method) {
                target.innerHTML = '<div class="quality-unavailable">Quality pilot unavailable. Live routing and the separate deterministic policy benchmark remain available.</div>';
                return;
            }
            const escapeHtml = value => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({
                '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": '''
            })[character]);
            const summary = evaluation.summary;
            const method = evaluation.method;
            const localModel = `${method.local_candidate?.provider || 'local'}/${method.local_candidate?.model || 'unknown'}`;
            const cloudModel = `${method.cloud_baseline?.provider || 'cloud'}/${method.cloud_baseline?.model || 'unknown'}`;
            const limitations = Array.isArray(method.limitations) ? method.limitations.join(' ') : '';
            target.innerHTML = `
                <div class="quality-grid">
                    <div class="quality-stat"><strong>${Number(summary.cases || 0)}</strong><span>Synthetic routine tasks</span></div>
                    <div class="quality-stat"><strong>${(Number(summary.smart_local_rate || 0) * 100).toFixed(0)}%</strong><span>Handled locally in Smart mode</span></div>
                    <div class="quality-stat"><strong class="text-emerald-300">${Number(summary.quality_retained_vs_cloud_percent || 0).toFixed(0)}%</strong><span>Quality retained vs cloud baseline</span></div>
                    <div class="quality-stat"><strong>${Number(summary.local_mean_score || 0).toFixed(1)} / ${Number(summary.cloud_mean_score || 0).toFixed(1)}</strong><span>Local / cloud mean score (1–5)</span></div>
                </div>
                <div class="quality-models">
                    <div class="quality-model"><span>Local candidate</span><strong>${escapeHtml(localModel)}</strong></div>
                    <div class="quality-model"><span>Cloud baseline</span><strong>${escapeHtml(cloudModel)}</strong></div>
                    <div class="quality-model"><span>Blind judge</span><strong>${escapeHtml(method.judge || 'Not disclosed')}</strong></div>
                </div>
                <div class="quality-cost">
                    Outcome: ${Number(summary.local_wins || 0)} local wins · ${Number(summary.ties || 0)} ties · ${Number(summary.cloud_wins || 0)} cloud wins.
                    Estimated evaluation spend: $${Number(summary.estimated_fireworks_judge_cost_usd || 0).toFixed(6)} judge + $${Number(summary.estimated_all_cloud_generation_cost_usd || 0).toFixed(6)} cloud generation.
                </div>
                <div class="quality-disclosure"><strong class="text-amber-200">Disclosure:</strong>
                    ${escapeHtml(evaluation.disclosure || limitations || 'Single blind LLM judge; not human evaluation and not a universal accuracy claim.')}
                    ${limitations && limitations !== evaluation.disclosure ? ` ${escapeHtml(limitations)}` : ''}
                </div>
            `;
        }

        async function updatePolicy() {
            const comp = parseFloat(document.getElementById('threshold-complexity').value);
            const red = parseFloat(document.getElementById('threshold-redact').value);
            const loc = parseFloat(document.getElementById('threshold-local').value);
            const btn = document.getElementById('btn-update-policy');
            btn.disabled = true;
            try {
                await callTool("update_routing_policy", { complexity_cloud_threshold: comp, privacy_redact_threshold: red, privacy_local_threshold: loc });
                alert("Policy updated!");
            } catch (err) { alert("Update failed: " + err.message); }
            finally { btn.disabled = false; }
        }

        async function updateHealth() {
            const container = document.getElementById('health-list');
            try {
                const health = await callTool("provider_health");
                let html = '';
                ['local', 'cloud'].forEach(p => {
                    const data = health[p]; if (!data) return;
                    html += `<div class="flex justify-between items-center"><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><div class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${data.available ? 'bg-green-500' : 'bg-red-500'}"></div><div><div class="font-medium">${data.provider || p}</div><div class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">${data.model || ''}</div></div></div><div class="text-xs ${data.available ? 'text-green-500' : 'text-red-400'}">${data.available ? (data.latency_ms ? data.latency_ms+'ms' : 'Ready') : (data.error || 'Offline')}</div></div>`;
                });
                container.innerHTML = html || '<div class="text-slate-500">No health data</div>';
            } catch (err) { container.innerHTML = `<div class="text-red-400 text-xs">${err.message}</div>`; }
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('[data-judge-preset]').forEach(button => {
            button.addEventListener('click', () => applyJudgePreset(button.dataset.judgePreset));
        });
        document.getElementById('btn-proof-check').addEventListener('click', recheckProofSamples);
        document.getElementById('feedback-correct').addEventListener('click', () => submitDecisionFeedback(true));
        document.getElementById('feedback-incorrect').addEventListener('click', () => submitDecisionFeedback(false));
        document.getElementById('btn-preview').addEventListener('click', runSimulation);
        document.getElementById('btn-submit').addEventListener('click', runRouting);
        document.getElementById('btn-refresh-metrics').addEventListener('click', refreshRouterData);
        document.getElementById('btn-copy-receipt').addEventListener('click', () => {
            const btn = document.getElementById('btn-copy-receipt');
            const receipt = document.getElementById('live-receipt');
            const range = document.createRange();
            range.selectNodeContents(receipt);
            const selection = window.getSelection();
            selection.removeAllRanges();
            selection.addRange(range);
            btn.textContent = "Selected — press Cmd/Ctrl+C";
            setTimeout(() => btn.textContent = "Select receipt", 3000);
        });
        ['complexity', 'redact', 'local'].forEach(id => {
            const el = document.getElementById(`threshold-${id}`);
            const val = document.getElementById(`val-${id}`);
            el.addEventListener('input', () => val.textContent = el.value);
        });

        init();
    </script>

enhancement.description: RouteForge is a privacy-aware MCP gateway that keeps sensitive or routine LLM requests local, redacts private data before permitted cloud processing, and returns an auditable receipt explaining every routing decision.
enhancement.prompt: Build me a tool that takes customer emails, pulls out their contact info and the issue they are reporting, and automatically drafts a professional response for me to review.
enhancement.response:
RouteForge is ready to help you manage and respond to customer service requests through your LLM-powered gateway.

- Extracts customer contact details and core issues from incoming messages using structured parsing.
- Generates professional, template-ready email drafts tailored to specific refund or service requests.
- Saves all processed summaries and response templates to your local file system for easy retrieval and editing.
- Utilizes the file management tool to maintain an audit trail of every customer interaction you process.

To use the app, simply provide a raw customer message, and the system will automatically parse the data and generate your response file.
